reviews.title: Feels so good with the red liner switches 😮‍💨 must get
reviews.comment: Got it for 89 bucks with tax and everything and I gotta say wow this is good I like creamy no sound but feeling smooth type gaming keyboards and am very happy with this one I recommend heavily and not loud at night it’s just perfect fella good quality not cheap definitely gunna be upgrading to the huntsman mini v3 pro soon just imagine how that good that one feels.
reviews.author: Mr. Papi

reviews.title: Small hands will love this keyboard.
reviews.comment: I always have had issues with keyboards and my hands. Since this keyboard is smaller no when gaming for hours. Love the quality, color, and size.
reviews.author: Nichole Rudy

reviews.title: good keyboard!
reviews.comment: The keyboard is very small, which could be interpreted as good or bad. build quality is wonderful and the keyboard feels great. i think it’s worth the money i paid. Zero lag as it is wired. the keyboard does not have arrow keys which i should have paid attention to when buying it. lighting effects are great and i love the snap tap technology
reviews.author: Elias Day

reviews.title: Keyboard
reviews.comment: Got this for my husband for his birthday since his keys were missing on his, great keyboard! It has LED and you can change the color and I got this in February, he has been using it and hasn’t said there was any issues or anything, he said the connectivity is good, it plugs into his computer and the appearance of the keyboard is nice, i was worried about getting white cause of greasy fingers when playing but its been 3 months and its still in perfect condition, im sure my husband will use this for years.
reviews.author: Katy

reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.comment: This is my first 60% keyboard and I love it. The keys are extremely responsive, and the key presses sound/feel good. The LED's are fairly bright they are on par with other razor products.
reviews.author: Zach M.
